Problem Statement:
Vicky is a bike rider. He studies Bsc. Maths in ABC college which functions on all the days except the two weekend days. His lives 40 kms away from his college, everyday the traffic varies and hence his average speed of driving also varies from day to day. You are his friend and you decide tgo calculate vicky's average speed of riding in a week while going to college. You fit a device in his bike whcih gives you the average speed of his bike everyday. Your task is to find out the average speed of his riding during the week. 
Input Description:
You will be given with the average speeds of each day 
Output Description:
One single number - average speed of Vicky 
Sample Input:
45.1 36.2 81.3 23.5 45 
Sample Output:
46.22 
Explanation:
